# FamParty

> A party game show for one big screen and everyone's phones. A host runs the show from their phone (or the first person to scan becomes host), a TV or shared screen only displays, and 2-12 players join with a QR code or 4-letter room code. No accounts, no app installs; free during beta, with no payments today.

FamParty is run by Hilly Shore Inc. (California, United States). Four games: Emoji Decoder (guess the phrase from emojis), Spotlight (two truths and a lie with a story beat), Spectrum (place yourself between opposites and predict the crowd), and Finish It (anonymous sentence completions, voted). Rooms are temporary and expire after about 2 hours; nothing is saved afterwards.

## Notes for agents

- Live rooms expire after about 2 hours. There are currently no saved stories, scores or accounts.
- The running app makes no AI model calls. Game content was generated offline with Muse Spark 1.3 (text) and Muse Image 1.0 (title-card art), then edited with Muse in OpenCode, and reviewed by Lloyd. It is not verbatim model output, and it was not tested with real people.
- App surfaces (/host, /join, /tv) are not for indexing.
